messages:
maria-partnerships: ACME asked about a co-host + download mirror for their Orchid-13B bundle. They want US-only downloads, a joint launch, and a marketplace SKU. can we map out infra/legal/billing asks?
laura-acme: hi all, wecan provide signed tarballs hourly and a provenance manifest. export restriction: ACME requests US-only due to third-party dataset concerns. happy to fill forms.
kevin-legal: from legal POV we'll need: 1) redistribution addendum (clarify permitted uses), 2) supplier attestation on training data provenance, 3) export classification doc, 4) indemnity and liability limits. also note we should add a takedown/embargo-lift clause for security or compliance flags.
eli-engineering: infra feasibility: yes. plan: ACME pushes hourly signed artifacts to a staging bucket we control. we verify signatures + checksums, then sync to a geo-restricted public bucket with signed URLs. mirror TTL should be configurable. need to confirm KMS for BYOK customers and whether ACME requires their own keys.
sam-platform: marketplace notes: need INF-8022 (billing + SKU mapping) and a product entry with metadata (model size, quantization options, pricing tiers). also approvals: sec-team review + IP/legal signoff before publish.
maria-partnerships: can we sketch a minimal timeline? ACME wants a joint blog + console "Partner Badge" and a 48h press window.
eli-engineering: timeline rough: infra ticket week1, canary (internal) week2, public listing week3 after sign-off. canary will validate 1k requests/day sample to check perf parity vs our hosted variant.
kevin-legal: i'll draft distro addendum this week but need ACME to complete the export questionnaire and attestations. also propose a limited SLA for mirror downloads (best-effort, with hosted API for production).
laura-acme: we'll return forms within 5 business days and provide contact for signing.
ops-bot: reminder: create INF-8022 and SEC-PR-45 security review. tagging sec-team and infra.
sam-platform: one operational detail: downloads should enforce geo-IP at the CDN edge, not just bucket ACLs. also rate-limit downloads per-customer (suggest 20 concurrent sessions default).
eli-engineering: agreed. implementation sketch for bucket policy: 
```
# pseudo-policy: CDN edge geo-block + origin restriction
if request.geo != "US": return 403
origin ACL: allow CDN-pop only
```
kevin-legal: flag: include attribution language in the console and blog draft. ACME wants co-branding; confirm trademark usage in addendum.
maria-partnerships: action items: 1) kevin to draft addendum (due Thu), 2) ACME to send export/classification + provenance (in 5 days), 3) sam to open INF-8022 and attach SKU metadata, 4) eli to draft sync/verify plan and canary checklist. i'll coordinate blog copy once legal/infra green.
laura-acme: thanks all. ping me if you need more provenance files; will prepare the co-branding assets.
kevin-legal: noted. will add embargo/takedown and trademark clause into the addendum. sending prelim to maria once ready. :thumbsup:
